The Houthi movement has carried out a second missile strike on Riyadh airport, killing a Pakistani national and causing multiple injuries. President Trump urged Ukraine to replace President Zelenskyy and linked the call to a diesel deal with Russia, while Zelenskyy said Ukraine would halt refinery strikes if Russia stops its energy attacks. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Iraq: the situation
item.description:
Iraq is dealing with multiple domestic crises, including a major hospital fire in Baghdad that forced more than 60 evacuations and a crackdown on a kidney-sale loan ring in the capital. The government barred security forces from intervening in the dollar exchange market and reiterated that they have no role in setting rates, while also warning that attacks on Riyadh’s King Khalid International Airport threaten regional stability. Iraq condemned the airport attack and warned that it could destabilise the region, and it is accelerating its air-defence upgrade to finish three years ahead of the coalition exit. The country’s prime minister is planning visits to Saudi Arabia and Kuwait, and Barzani met the Finnish ambassador to discuss security and ties between Erbil and Baghdad. The conflict recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
